title: Cathedral City?
content: I mentioned this before but I usually have city dreams. I've had a few mallworld dreams... but lately a cathedral city has emerged for me (sometimes it blends with the other worlds.) I've had (seldom) cathedral cities for about 2 years now Features of Cathedral City: Stone Architecture (roads, buildings, pavements. It seems to be the only building material (except for glass windows) It appears to be located in Western Europe It features large Roman style amphitheatres, the Sagrada Familia, St Pauls Cathedral and similar buildings. It is quite densly populated, with a real city buzz (rush hour)
